description: Inspect project environments and their deployments. Actions: list (environments filtered by state/name), get (single environment with its last deployment), list_deployments (deployment history, filterable by environment and status). Related: manage_environment to create.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get, list_deployments

environment.description: Filter deployments by environment name Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

environment_id.description: Numeric ID of the environment Required for 'get' action(s).

finished_after.description: Return deployments finished after this ISO 8601 date (requires order_by=finished_at) Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

finished_before.description: Return deployments finished before this ISO 8601 date (requires order_by=finished_at) Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

name.description: Return the environment with this exact name Required for 'list' action(s).

order_by.description: Order deployments by field (default: id) Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list', 'list_deployments' action(s).

search.description: Return environments matching this search term (min 3 characters) Required for 'list' action(s).

sort.description: Sort direction (default: asc) Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

states.description: Filter environments by state Required for 'list' action(s).

status.description: Filter deployments by status Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

updated_after.description: Return deployments updated after this ISO 8601 date Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

updated_before.description: Return deployments updated before this ISO 8601 date Required for 'list_deployments' action(s).

name: browse_environments
